actus.title: tenacious, talented Corentin Horeau
actus.excerpt: Before this Tuesday—and the joy of crossing the finish line in Pointe-à-Pitre—Corentin Horeau had already realized one of his dreams: winning the Solitaire du Figaro. That was in September 2023, a hard-fought victory which came after years of trying and many disappointments.

actus.title: Basile Bourgnon, wins the Route du Rhum - Destination Guadeloupe in the Ocean Fifty class*
actus.excerpt: Young French skipper Basile Bourgnon held firm to the very end,  winning the Ocean Fifty class on the Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe in the very early hours of this morning. His is a win full of flair and symbolic significance.
